gen-dafont-over-there-gf-david-libre: Stencil-era swagger, all wide gaps between letters. David Libre takes over below with a text serif's hanging open terminals, while Over There handles the commanding shouting and the body does the patient, dignified talking.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-enriqueta: Enriqueta reads literary and dignified, its curves stopping short of closing like chalk lifted early. Over There stays blunt up top with no swelling where curves meet stems, so Enriqueta can carry a long passage with a slow, bookish unrolling.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-gentium-plus: Commanding, with a drill-sergeant's spacing between letters. Gentium Plus brings wide-mouthed c shapes and a refined classic serif manner, and the two share one quality: each reads like following a single thread.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-gowun-batang: Spaghetti-like lines, laid out in wide-spaced military letters. Gowun Batang follows with cut-back terminals that leave big gaps, so a longer passage would move in a refined, literary, unhurried way.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-habibi: Habibi brings a traditional, editorial text serif, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. And Over There, drawn with rounds and stems in one weight, lets a longer passage settle into a vintage-military march before it.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-inika: Inika reads as classic and traditional, with a see-through gap in each s. And Over There, whose bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mix in a word, gives the pair its strongest quality: a firm, commanding contrast of voices.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-kay-pho-du: Vintage-military and blunt, with generous spacing. Kay Pho Du answers in a traditional serif with counters like a hollow reed cut open, so a longer passage moves along one single-width, rolling-ball line.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-labrada: Over There brings a vintage-military, commanding look, its outline thick-only and its letters spaced wide apart. Labrada, a dignified text serif, does the bookish work, opening up its small letters.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-montaga: Wide-spaced, nib-drawn, quite sure of itself. Montaga follows as a bookish, editorial text serif whose pen-lifted curves leave loops unfinished, and that stitched-thread quality is what makes this pairing stand out.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-new-tegomin: New Tegomin is a dignified, traditional text serif with a c like a wide-open ring. And Over There, cut with an engraver's single depth, sits beside it like a stern, vintage-military sign over a quiet room.
